name: Python-like language with Hindley-Milner type inference

mentions.name: Python-like language with Hindley-Milner type inference
mentions.description: An experimental programming language similar to Python that incorporates Hindley-Milner type inference and functional programming features. It explores how HM typing, combined with well-encapsulated escape hatches, can map onto the Python ecosystem and its dynamism.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm toying around with a language that's like Python but with Hindley-Miller interference and some functional stuff. It's not a superset or anything, because I can't do that, but it's interesting how well HM (plus some well-encapsulated escape hatches) map onto the Python ecosystem with all its dynamism.
